pr_title: CI: add verified dispatcher post-push recovery
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a trusted post-push recovery workflow with no product branch write permission
- prove an already-pushed target commit exactly matches the published schema-v2 request before PR/validation reconciliation
- retry transient GitHub 5xx failures while creating or reconciling the Draft PR and dispatching exact-head Windows Validation
- add regression coverage and document the recovery contract

## Trigger

ADR0126 v4 request `adr0126-current-main-replay-v4-20260817-2350` pushed commit `627b0dd31de5c592e5a0549ff3d49c0a7c9beda5`, then the normal Dispatcher failed on GitHub GraphQL HTTP 503 before Draft PR creation and Windows Validation dispatch. Replaying normal apply is unsafe because the target already moved.

## Trust boundary

The recovery workflow has `contents: read`, `pull-requests: write`, and `actions: write`. It cannot modify the product branch. It shares the normal Dispatcher concurrency group and requires exact request/commit/diff/baseline verification before it can reconcile review metadata.

## Validation

Automation regression and Windows validation must pass before merge. Production post-push recovery remains unverified until this Draft PR is reviewed and merged by the user.
